title: People and Plants
description: How can we develop resilient food systems by using traditional indigenous knowledge? This course examines this broad question by examining the relationship between people and plants. The topic can be approached by focusing on the relationship in the present, referred to as ethnobotany; or that which occurred in the past, referred to as paleoethnobotany or archeobotany. The course provides an overview of the concepts that cover both the past and present, methods utilized in their study, and describes cases examples as illustrations.
